title: Save the run's work under a new name, or discard it and close, with Connector.Settle and confirm_lifecycle_actions
task: Save a document as a file or close it at the end of the run that wrote to it: call Connector.Settle(doc, keep) to end the run's transaction group in the stated direction, then Document.SaveAs or Document.Close, with execute_script confirm_lifecycle_actions: true. Without Settle Revit refuses lifecycle calls; without the flag the script is refused with script-lifecycle-confirmation-required.

pitfalls.symptom: `script-lifecycle-confirmation-required`: refused before running because the script calls Document.Close, Save, SaveAs, SynchronizeWithCentral or Print.
pitfalls.cause: These act on the person's session, the filesystem, the central model or a printer, outside the rollback boundary.
pitfalls.fix: Ask the user, then pass confirm_lifecycle_actions: true to execute_script.

pitfalls.symptom: SaveAs/Close throws that a transaction or transaction group is still open, right after the script wrote to the document.
pitfalls.cause: The run's group is open on every document it wrote to; Revit's transaction-phase check runs before the lifecycle event even fires.
pitfalls.fix: Connector.Settle(doc, keep: true) before SaveAs (keep: false to discard before Close).

pitfalls.symptom: After SaveAs the document cannot be found by its old title.
pitfalls.cause: Title becomes the saved file's basename.
pitfalls.fix: Read doc.Title after SaveAs and use that for later lookups and cleanup.

pitfalls.symptom: Settle(keep: false) and the run's mutations report shows nothing for that document.
pitfalls.cause: Discarded writes are rolled back before the report is built.
pitfalls.fix: Expected; keep: true is what makes writes permanent.

pitfalls.symptom: 'The referenced object is not valid' right after doc.Close(false).
pitfalls.cause: Close disposes the document; reading Title (or anything) from the closed wrapper throws.
pitfalls.fix: Capture the title before Close and check Application.Documents by that string.
